kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتبرنس (form IIq)
# نَتَبَرْنَسُ (natabarnasu) /na.ta.bar.na.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَرْنَسَ (tabarnasa)
# نَتَبَرْنَسَ (natabarnasa) /na.ta.bar.na.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَرْنَسَ (tabarnasa)
# نَتَبَرْنَسْ (natabarnas) /na.ta.bar.nas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَرْنَسَ (tabarnasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
